decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service sits close to the core offer, and its promotion to a dedicated page in 2024 shows growing visible commitment that management will want to justify.

The open GIS framework embodies the announced strategy of open, extensible components and represents substantial sunk development effort, so management will persist with it even though its web presence did not grow.
The identity service was publicly launched as new, has its own page, and is central to integrating GeoIT into enterprise systems, so public commitment and strategic fit strongly favor keeping it.
The consulting workshop was only launched in 2024 and builds on core consulting know-how, so any weak early results can still be attributed to the start-up phase.
